starting-the-quest-before-the-quest-is-s.text: If the player does not have 35 Runecraft:

steps.player: Hello there!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Oh, hello. I'd love to chat right now, but I'm a bit busy. Perhaps you could come back and chat another time?

steps.player: Of course. Sorry to bother you!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Not at all! Farewell!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Hello there. I'm Rat.

steps.player: You're a what?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: No, no. My name is Rat. Rat Burgiss.

steps.player: Ohhhhh, well, what's up, Ratty?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: It's Rat, thank you. And I, uh...heh...I seem to be in a bit of trouble here, as you can probably see.

steps.player: Why, what seems to be the matter?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Well, I'm a trader by nature and I was on the way to Varrock with my cart here when I was set upon by outlaws! They ransacked my cart and stole some very important papers that I must get back.

options.text: That's awful! You're lucky to be alive!

steps.player: That's awful! You're lucky to be alive!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Yes, I know! I don't know how I survived.

steps.player: Maybe you weren't worth killing?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Look, do you want to help me or not?

steps.prompt: Start the What Lies Below quest?

steps.player: Of course! Tell me what you need me to do.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Right, now I heard those outlaws say something about having a small camp site somewhere to the north-west of Varrock. They headed off to the north-west of here. They took 5 pages with them.
If the player has inventory space:

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Kill the outlaws and get those papers back from them for me. Here's a folder in which you can put the pages. Be careful, though; those outlaws are tough.
An empty folder

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: When you find all 5 pages, put them in the folder and bring them back to me!

steps.player: Don't worry, Ratty! I won't let you down!

steps.text: If the player does not have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Oh, wait a minute. I was going to give you a folder in which to collect my papers, but you haven't got enough room for it. Talk to me when you do.

steps.player: No, sorry, I have to go!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Oh well. I'll just wait here then and maybe some nice person will help me. Perhaps...one day...

steps.player: Uh, are you guilt tripping me?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: No! Not at all! Nuh-uh! Nope! Hardly! Noooo, no no no!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Well, maybe a bit...

steps.player: Well, good luck with that!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Thanks!

steps.player: No, that's not what...oh, never mind!

options.text: The papers were the only valuable thing you had?

steps.player: The papers were the only valuable thing you had?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Uh...yes. I guess so.

steps.player: So you don't sell anything worth having?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Ah! Uhh...no, not really.

steps.player: You're not much of a trader are you?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: No...I mean yes... Look, that's besides the point. Can you help me?

options.text: Shall I get them back for you?

steps.player: Shall I get them back for you?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: You mean you want to help?

options.text: Oh dear. Well, I hope you get to Varrock okay!

steps.player: Oh dear. Well, I hope you get to Varrock okay!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Uh...so you can't help me?

steps.player: Sorry. I'm a bit busy right now.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Don't you want another quest?

steps.player: No thanks. I'm too busy right now.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Well, fine!

steps.player: Fine!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Good!

steps.player: Good!!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: So go then!

steps.player: I'm going!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Go then!

steps.player: I'm gone!

starting-the-quest-talking-to-rat-burgis.text: If the player did not have inventory space for the folder:

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Ah! You're back! Excellent!

steps.player: Of course! Tell me what you need me to do.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Right, now I heard those outlaws say something about having a small camp site somewhere to the north-west of Varrock. They headed off to the north-west of here. They took 5 pages with them.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Kill the outlaws and get those papers back from them for me. Here's a folder in which you can put the pages. Be careful, though; those outlaws are tough.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: When you find all 5 pages, put them in the folder and bring them back to me!

steps.player: Don't worry, Ratty! I won't let you down!

starting-the-quest-talking-to-rat-burgis.text: If the player has the folder and talks to Rat Burgiss again:

steps.player: I can't remember what I am supposed to do!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Head north-west from here into the forest north-west of Varrock. Find the Outlaw Camp and kill the outlaws there.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Collect the pages of my document for me and put them into the folder I gave you. When the folder contains 5 pages, bring it to me!
If the player lost the folder:

steps.player: I lost the folder you gave me. Do you have another one?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Sure. Here you go. I'll add it to your account.
An empty folder

steps.player: My account? Am I in debt?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: No, it's just the way you're standing!

steps.player: Okay, thanks!

starting-the-quest-talking-to-rat-burgis.text: If the player uses the empty folder on Rat Burgiss:

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Yes, that's the folder I gave you. I need you to fill it with pages for me.

collecting-the-pages-using-the-folder-an.text: If the player uses one of Rat's papers on Rat Burgiss:

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Yes! That's one of my papers! Gather all 5 of them and put them into that folder I gave to you.

collecting-the-pages-using-the-folder-an.text: If the player uses a used folder on Rat Burgiss:

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Ah! It looks like you have found some of the pages I need. You still need more, though.

collecting-the-pages-using-the-pages-on-.text: If the player uses one of the papers on the empty folder:

steps.text: You add the page to the folder that Rat gave you.
You need to find [1-4] more page[s].

collecting-the-pages-using-the-pages-on-.text: If the player uses the last paper on the used folder:

steps.text: You add the last page to Rat's folder. You should take this back to Rat as soon as possible.
You have added all the pages to the folder that Rat gave to you. You should take this folder back to Rat.

collecting-the-pages-reading-the-documen.text: If the player reads the empty folder:

steps.text: The folder is empty at the moment so there is nothing inside to read!

collecting-the-pages-reading-the-documen.text: If the player reads one of the pages or reads the used folder:

steps.text: The piece of paper appears to contain lots of facts and figures. They look like accounts and lists of items. You're not sure what they all mean.

handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.player: Hey, Rat! I got your pages back!

handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.speaker: Rat Burgiss
handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.text: Excellent! I knew you could help! Let me take those from you, there.
a full folder and extra pages (if present) to Rat Burgiss

handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.speaker: Rat Burgiss
handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.text: Now, I liked the way you handled yourself on that last little 'mission' I gave you there, so I'm going to let you in on a little secret!

handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.player: Wait! Wait! Let me guess! You're actually a rich prince in disguise who wants to help poor people like me!?

handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.speaker: Rat Burgiss
handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.text: Uhhh...no. No, that's not it. You know, on second thought, I think I'll keep my secret for now. Look, instead, you can do another job for me.

handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.player: All work and no play makes [player name] a dull adventurer!

handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.speaker: Rat Burgiss
handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.text: Yes, well, I'm sure that may be the case. However, what I want you to do is take this letter to someone for me. It's in a different language so, trust me, you won't be able to read it.

handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.speaker: Rat Burgiss
handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.text: Take it to a wizard named Surok Magis who resides in the Varrock Place Library. I'll see about some sort of reward for your work when I get myself sorted out here.

handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.player: Letter. Wizard. Varrock. Library. Got it!

handing-the-completed-folder-over-to-rat.text: If the player loses the letter to Surok:

steps.player: Rat, I think I lost that letter you gave me!

steps.text: If the player does not have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: That's probably because you've replaced it with something else, by the looks of it! Talk to me when you have some space in your inventory!
another letter to Surok

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Goodness me! Not much of a messenger, are you? Here's another one; try not to lose it this time! I've charged the parchment to your account.

steps.player: Will you take a cheque?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: No thanks. I prefer tartan.

talking-to-surok-magis.speaker: Surok Magis
talking-to-surok-magis.text: Hah! Come for my Aphro-Dizzy-Yak spell! Want someone to fall madly in love with you, eh? Not surprised with a face like that, to be honest!

talking-to-surok-magis.player: I didn't come here to be insulted!

talking-to-surok-magis.speaker: Surok Magis
talking-to-surok-magis.text: Really? Well, with ears like that, you do surprise me!

talking-to-surok-magis.player: No, look. I have a letter for you.

talking-to-surok-magis.speaker: Surok Magis
talking-to-surok-magis.text: Really? Well then, let me see it!
If the player does not have the letter:

steps.player: Oh. I had it here a moment ago. Where is it?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Hah! You've lost it already? You can't get good help these days!

steps.player: I'm very sorry! Let me go get another one!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: As you must! Now be off with you! I'm busy studying here!

talking-to-surok-magis.text: If the player has the letter:

steps.player: Here it is!

talking-to-surok-magis.player: Why did you destroy the letter?

talking-to-surok-magis.speaker: Surok Magis
talking-to-surok-magis.text: None of your business! It's a secret!

talking-to-surok-magis.player: Yes, there seems to be a lot of them going around at the moment.

talking-to-surok-magis.speaker: Surok Magis
talking-to-surok-magis.text: Of course. Hmmm. However, I could let you in on another secret, if you like?

steps.player: Go on, then!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: My secret is this. I have been spending time here in the palace library trying to discover some ancient spells and magics.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: In my research, I have uncovered a most astounding spell that will allow me to transform simple clay into solid gold bars!

steps.player: Okay, what do you need?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: I will only need a couple of items. The first is very simple: an ordinary bowl to use as a casting vessel.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: You should be able to find one of these at any local store here in Varrock. I would go myself but I am...uh...busy with my research.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: The other item is much harder. I need a metal wand infused with chaos magic.

steps.player: How would I get something like that?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Take this metal wand. You will also need 15 chaos runes. When you get to the Chaos Altar, use the wand on the altar itself. This should infuse the runes into the wand.
a wand and Sin'keth's diary

steps.player: How on earth do you know about Runecrafting? I thought only a few people knew of it.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Hah! Don't presume to think that those wizards in their fancy tower are the only people to have heard of Runecrafting! Now pay attention!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: You will need to have the 15 chaos runes in your inventory. Make sure you also have either a chaos talisman or chaos tiara to complete the infusion.

steps.player: Where can I get a talisman or a tiara?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: I'm afraid I don't know. You will need to search for one.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Bring the infused wand and a bowl back to me and I will make us both rich!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: One more thing. I have uncovered information here in the library which may be of use to you. It tells of a safe route to the Chaos Altar that avoids the Wilderness.

steps.player: Great! What is it?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: It is an old tome...a history book of sorts. It's somewhere here in the library. I forget where I left it, but it should be easy enough for you to find.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: I have also given you a copy of a diary I...uh...acquired. It may also help you to find that which you seek.

steps.player: Is it a BIG secret?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: It's a very big secret!

steps.player: Bigger than a house?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Er, yes! It's...

steps.player: Bigger than a volcano??

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Yes. Look, it's big, alright? Now listen and I'll tell you.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: My secret is this. I have been spending time here in the palace library trying to discover some ancient spells and magics.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: In my research, I have uncovered a most astounding spell that will allow me to transform simple clay into solid gold bars!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Now I am ready to use the spell to create all the gold I...uh...the city wants. I would gladly share this gold with you; I simply need a few more things!

steps.player: Okay, what do you need?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: I will only need a couple of items. The first is very simple: an ordinary bowl to use as a casting vessel.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: You should be able to find one of these at any local store here in Varrock. I would go myself but I am...uh...busy with my research.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: The other item is much harder. I need a metal wand infused with chaos magic.

steps.player: How would I get something like that?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Take this metal wand. You will also need 15 chaos runes. When you get to the Chaos Altar, use the wand on the altar itself. This should infuse the runes into the wand.

steps.player: How on earth do you know about Runecrafting? I thought only a few people knew of it.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Hah! Don't presume to think that those wizards in their fancy tower are the only people to have heard of Runecrafting! Now pay attention!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: You will need to have the 15 chaos runes in your inventory. Make sure you also have either a chaos talisman or chaos tiara to complete the infusion.

steps.player: Where can I get a talisman or a tiara?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: I'm afraid I don't know. You will need to search for one.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Bring the infused wand and a bowl back to me and I will make us both rich!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: One more thing. I have uncovered information here in the library which may be of use to you. It tells of a safe route to the Chaos Altar that avoids the Wilderness.

steps.player: Great! What is it?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: It is an old tome...a history book of sorts. It's somewhere here in the library. I forget where I left it, but it should be easy enough for you to find.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: I have also given you a copy of a diary I...uh...acquired. It may also help you to find that which you seek.

options.text: No thanks. I have other things to do for now!

steps.player: No thanks. I have other things to do for now!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Very well, then. I hope these other matters of 'great' importance outweigh the need to make a LOT of gold. A WHOLE lot of gold. Gold. Yes, gold.

steps.player: Uh, why are you repeating yourself like that?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Dramatic effect.

steps.player: Oh.

talking-to-surok-magis-talking-to-surok-.speaker: Surok Magis
talking-to-surok-magis-talking-to-surok-.text: Ah! You're back. Have you found the things I need yet?

options.text: Remind me what I am doing again?

steps.player: Remind me what I am doing again?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Take this metal wand. You will also need 15 chaos runes. When you get to the Chaos Altar, use the wand on the altar itself. This should infuse the runes into the wand.

steps.player: I lost the wand!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Somehow, I knew that would happen so I have made a few spares for just such an occasion!
If the wand is still in the player's inventory:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Here you g...hang on! There's one still in your inventory! I just saw it! You don't need two and they're not worth anything...yet! Now get going already; there's not much time!
If the wand is in the player's bank:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: You would lie to an arch-wizard? There is one in your bank! I can sense it! Go and retrieve that one first!
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: You have no space for another one! Lose some of that useless junk in your inventory first!
If the player has inventory space:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Here you are. Try not to lose this one!

options.text: How much gold will I get?

steps.player: How much gold will I get?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Hmmmm. That all depends on how quickly you get me that infused wand! Work fast and well for me, [player name], and I will make you rich, famous and powerful!

steps.player: Really? Powerful, eh? How powerful?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: That depends.

steps.player: Depends on what?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: On how soon you stop yapping and get me that wand! Now get moving!

options.text: Can I ask about the diary?

steps.player: Can I ask about the diary?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Of course. What would you like to know?

steps.player: Who is this Sin'keth?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Sin'keth Magis? From what I have read, it would appear he was a great leader of the Dagon'hai Mages.

steps.player: The Dagon-what?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Hmph! If you read the diary or perused that tome I mentioned, you would know who they are.

steps.player: Hey, wait! Isn't your last name Magis too? Are you related to him?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: No. Not at all. Purely coincidence! Now, haven't you got work to do already?

steps.player: Where did it come from?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: How I came to have the diary is of no concern to you!

steps.player: Oooo, tetchy!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: I suggest that you concentrate on getting the things I need and stop asking pointless questions!

steps.player: Where is the safe route?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: I could tell you, of course; I know more or less exactly where it is. However, that would take all the fun out of this, wouldn't it?

steps.player: No, really! It's okay! You can tell me where it is!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: No, I think you should see if you can find it for yourself. I have given you the diary and, along with the tome around here, you should be able to find that alternate route easily enough on your own!

steps.player: Can I have another one?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: You want another copy of the diary?

steps.player: Yes, I seem to have misplaced the last one.

steps.text: If the diary is still in the player's inventory:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Hang on! I can see the last copy I gave you in your inventory there! You don't need another one!
If the player does not have the diary in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Fine, but this diary is important you know! It has secrets that you should not share around with just anybody!
Sin'keth's diary either in their inventory or on the ground if the player has no inventory space

options.text: Never mind, I forgot the question.

steps.player: Never mind, I forgot the question.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Fair enough. Go then. I expect you have a lot of work to do!

options.text: Where is that tome you mentioned again?

steps.player: Where is that tome you mentioned, again?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Like I said, it's lying around here in the library somewhere. It should be easy enough to find.

talking-to-surok-magis-talking-to-surok-.text: If the player uses the wand on Surok:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Yes, I just gave that to you. Don't break it already!

talking-to-surok-magis-talking-to-surok-.text: If the player uses the diary on Surok:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: No thanks, I don't need that.

talking-to-rat-burgiss-after-handing-the.speaker: Rat Burgiss
talking-to-rat-burgiss-after-handing-the.text: Ah, [player name]! Good to see you! I heard you got my letter to Surok. Well done!

talking-to-rat-burgiss-after-handing-the.player: That's right! I did your leg work. Now, how about a reward?

talking-to-rat-burgiss-after-handing-the.speaker: Rat Burgiss
talking-to-rat-burgiss-after-handing-the.text: Yes, of course! I'd be happy to give you a reward, but I have a lot on my mind with...you know...trader...stuff!

statue-of-saradomin-attempting-to-dig-th.speaker: Anna Jones
statue-of-saradomin-attempting-to-dig-th.text: You're going to need a bronze pickaxe to get through there!

statue-of-saradomin-attempting-to-dig-th.player: A bronze one? Why bronze? They're pretty cheap and tacky.

statue-of-saradomin-attempting-to-dig-th.speaker: Anna Jones
statue-of-saradomin-attempting-to-dig-th.text: Well, I don't claim to have a lot of knowledge about the ways of magic, but there's a strange protection spell on there.

statue-of-saradomin-attempting-to-dig-th.speaker: Anna Jones
statue-of-saradomin-attempting-to-dig-th.text: Yes. Apparently the makers of this tunnel protected it against all forms of pickaxes except bronze.

statue-of-saradomin-attempting-to-dig-th.speaker: Anna Jones
statue-of-saradomin-attempting-to-dig-th.text: I don't think they thought anyone would actually try and use a bronze pickaxe as it's such a poor instrument!

statue-of-saradomin-attempting-to-dig-th.player: I see. Well, thanks for the help.

statue-of-saradomin-talking-to-anna-jone.speaker: Anna Jones
statue-of-saradomin-talking-to-anna-jone.text: Ah. You must be [player name], right? I have a bronze pickaxe here for you!
If the player does not have a bronze pickaxe:

steps.text: a bronze pickaxe

steps.player: Thanks very much!

steps.speaker: Anna Jones
steps.text: My employer, Surok Magis, sent word to me that you may come to use the tunnel. You will need something to help you get in there. The pickaxe I've given to you should help.

steps.player: Uh, thanks.

steps.speaker: Anna Jones
steps.text: Okay, then. The tunnel awaits...

statue-of-saradomin-talking-to-anna-jone.text: If the player has a bronze pickaxe in their inventory:

steps.player: Thanks, but I already have one.

steps.speaker: Anna Jones
steps.text: Oh. Alright then! My employer, Surok Magis, sent word to me that you may come to use the tunnel. You'll need your bronze pickaxe to get in there.

steps.player: Uh, thanks.

steps.speaker: Anna Jones
steps.text: Okay, then. The tunnel awaits...

statue-of-saradomin-talking-to-anna-jone.text: If the player does not have level 42 Mining:

steps.text: The player starts mining the statue of Saradomin for five seconds.

steps.player: Hmm...

steps.text: The player keeps mining for another five seconds.

steps.speaker: Anna Jones
steps.text: Be careful! You're going to bring the statue down on both of our heads if you go swinging wildly away like that.

steps.player: So what should I do?

steps.speaker: Anna Jones
steps.text: I would suggest you improve your Mining skills a bit before you attempt this.

steps.player: Okay, I'd better go and train some more then!

steps.text: The statue begins to shake. You're going to need a Mining level of at least 42 to excavate under here!

statue-of-saradomin-talking-to-anna-jone.text: If the player has at least level 42 Mining:

steps.text: The player starts mining the statue of Saradomin for five seconds.

steps.player: Hmm...

steps.text: The player keeps mining for another five seconds, and a tunnel is excavated.
TThe tunnel shudders as you carefully dig away enough of the crumbling rock to make an entrance big enough to climb through.

steps.speaker: Anna Jones
steps.text: You did it! Oh, well done! How exciting!

steps.player: Right, well, I better see what's down there, then.

statue-of-saradomin-talking-to-anna-jone.text: If the player talks to Anna Jones before entering the tunnel:

steps.speaker: Anna Jones
steps.text: You opened the tunnel; well done!

steps.player: Aren't you going to go inside?

steps.speaker: Anna Jones
steps.text: I'd better not. My orders were to open up the entrance and wait for Surok to arrive. When he gets here, we'll go in together. He promised me a lot of gold for this job!

steps.player: Okay, then. I'm going in to have a look!

imbuing-the-wand-at-the-chaos-altar.text: If the player attempts to use the wand on the altar without 15 chaos runes:

steps.text: The wand sparks and glows, but the infusion does not appear to take hold. It looks like you will need more chaos runes to complete the infusion.

imbuing-the-wand-at-the-chaos-altar.text: If the player uses the wand on the altar with 15 chaos runes in their inventory:

steps.text: The metal wand bursts into life and crackles with arcane power. This is a powerful instrument indeed!

imbuing-the-wand-at-the-chaos-altar-talk.text: If the player uses the infused wand on Rat Burgiss:

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: What on earth is that?

steps.player: I can't tell you. It's a secret!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: I see! It looks pretty magical; I'd be careful with that if I were you!

imbuing-the-wand-at-the-chaos-altar-talk.text: If the player uses the diary on Rat Burgiss:

steps.text: Rat doesn't need that. You should keep it.

talking-to-surok-after-imbuing-the-wand-.text: If the player loses the imbued wand or uses an empty bowl with the imbued wand in their bank:

steps.player: I made the wand that you asked me for, but I seem to have lost it!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: You lost it? Those wands are extremely powerful and dangerous in the wrong hands! You better hope someone doesn't find it!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Hmph! In the meantime, here's another metal wand. Go and make another infused wand for me...and be more careful this time! My patience is growing thin!

talking-to-surok-after-imbuing-the-wand-.text: If the player infuses the wand but has a regular wand in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Well?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: You say you made the infused wand for me? Then why do you still have that metal wand I gave you? Go and do what I ask before I lose my temper and turn you into a worm or something!

options.text: I have the things you wanted!

steps.player: I have the things you wanted!

steps.text: If the player does not have a bowl in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: No, it looks like you still need to find me a bowl first. An ordinary bowl. You can get one from one of the stores around here.
If the player has a bowl in their inventory:

steps.player: I have the things you wanted!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Excellent! Well done! I knew that you would not let me down.

steps.player: So...about this gold that you're going to give me?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: All in good time. I must prepare the spell first, and that will take a little time. While I am doing that, please take this letter to Rat, the trader outside the city who sent you here.
Surok's letter

steps.player: Okay, but I'll be back for my gold.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Yes, yes, yes. Now off you go!

options.text: Can I ask about the diary?

steps.player: Can I ask about the diary?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Of course. What would you like to know?

options.text: Never mind, I forgot the question.

steps.player: Never mind, I forgot the question.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Fair enough. Go then. I expect you have a lot of work to do!

options.text: Never mind, I forgot the question.

talking-to-surok-after-imbuing-the-wand-.text: If the player destroys the letter without reading it:

steps.player: I seem to have lost that letter you gave me!

steps.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Goodness me! You do lose a lot of things! It's a wonder you can make it out of bed in the mornings! Well, here's another one!
another letter to Surok

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: It's not surprising with all that junk in your inventory! Get some room, first, then speak to me again!

talking-to-surok-after-imbuing-the-wand-.text: If the player destroys the letter after reading it:

steps.player: That letter was treasonous so I destroyed it!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Really? You destroyed it?

steps.player: Yes!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: You want another one, don't you?

steps.player: Ah...uh...yes...yes, I do.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Fine. Here you are. And stop all this complaining; it's getting me down!

steps.player: Who are you really?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: That is not your concern! I am Surok Magis and I am more powerful than you can possibly imagine!

steps.player: So what's in it for me?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: You get to live. For now.

steps.player: Not that I'm complaining about the living part, but I was expecting something of more...er...value?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Ah, yes. The gold. Don't you worry, I am still working on that. Just deliver my letter for me, first. Now be off!

steps.player: Fine. I will deliver the letter, but I will be back soon.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: I am sure you will.

options.text: Do I still get the gold?

steps.player: Do I still get the gold?

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: If that is your only concern, then yes, you do. But I must warn you, my patience with you is wearing thin. So go now and do my bidding!

steps.player: Fine. I will deliver the letter, but I will be back soon.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: I am sure you will.

options.text: Never mind, I forgot the question.

talking-to-surok-after-imbuing-the-wand-.speaker: King Roald
talking-to-surok-after-imbuing-the-wand-.text: Yes, citizen. Do you need something?

options.text: Your majesty, I think that you should see this letter.

steps.player: Your majesty, I think that you should see this letter.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Letter? Let me see. Where's Postie Pete? He usually deals with the mail around here.

steps.player: This letter was delivered to me by hand, your majesty. I think you may be in some danger.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Hmmm. I see. I appreciate your concern. However, I assure you, I am quite safe here. My guards are on full alert at all times.

steps.player: I don't think you understand...

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: I understand perfectly. Now, for all I know, that letter could be a fake ruse. We get a lot of that sort of thing and it causes a lot of hassle.

steps.player: I'm trying to save your life!

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: And you are shouting at your king! People who yell at their monarchs often find their heads become...loose!

steps.player: I'm just saying that the letter is real.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Then why do you have it?

steps.player: Because I'm supposed to deliv...oh.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: It seems to me that if that letter were genuine, I would be forced to arrest its bearer for treason. You understand.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: So what do you say?

steps.player: I...er...I reckon it's a fake! ...I guess...

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Just as I thought! Now off you go!

options.text: Yes! I have a letter for you.

steps.player: Yes! I have a letter for you.

steps.text: The player gives the letter to Rat, and he takes a few seconds to read it.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: This letter is treasonous! This does indeed confirm my worst fears. It is time I let you into my secret and hopefully this will answer any questions you may have.

steps.player: Okay. Go on.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: I am not really a trader. I am the Commander of the Varrock Palace Secret Guard. VPSG for short.

steps.player: Okay, I had a feeling you weren't a real trader due to the fact that you had nothing to sell! So why the secrecy?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: I'm just getting to that. A short while ago, we received word that Surok had discovered a powerful mind-control spell and intended to use it on King Roald himself!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: He could control the whole kingdom that way!

steps.player: I think I can believe that. Surok's not the nicest person in Misthalin!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Yes, but until now, the spell has been useless to him as he is currently under guard at the palace and not allowed to leave. He could not get the tools for the spell because if he left the palace he would be arrested!

steps.player: Uh oh! I think I may have helped him by mistake, here. He promised me a big reward if I collected some items for him...but he said it was for a spell to make gold!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Yes, we heard that somehow Surok had obtained the things he needed but we were not sure how. I thought it might have been you.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: However, I assumed you did not know of his plans; that is why you weren't arrested!

steps.player: Thank you! How can I help fix this mistake?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Okay, here's what I need you to do. One of my contacts has devised a spell that he is sure will be able to counteract the effects of the mind-control spell. I need you to visit him.

steps.player: Okay, who is it?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: His name is Zaff. He runs a staff shop in Varrock. Go and speak to him and he will tell you what you should do. I will send word to him to let him know that you are coming.

steps.player: Yes, sir! I'm on my way!

options.text: Yes, and you have some explaining to do!

steps.player: Yes, and you have some explaining to do!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Why? Whatever do you mean?

steps.player: This letter from Surok to you implies that you're involved in a treasonous plot! I should tell the guards about you!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: I'm sure I don't know what you mean. Let me see the letter, please.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: This letter is treasonous! This does indeed confirm my worst fears. It is time I let you into my secret and hopefully this will answer any questions you may have.

What, you're still here?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Yes. I still haven't found someone to help me yet, but I hear you've been very busy yourself!

steps.player: You have? Who told you that?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Oh, I have my sources. Was there anything else?

steps.player: What am I doing now?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: You need to go and see Zaff. He can be found at 'Zaffs Staffs', the staff shop in Varrock. He will tell you what to do next.

options.text: Do you think we can stop Surok?

steps.player: Do you think we can stop Surok?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Surok is a powerful mage and ruthless too. Who knows what will happen. I am sure that we will prevail, though. Don't worry, [player name]! You'll be fine!

options.text: Do you think we can stop Surok?

steps.player: Do you have anything to trade yet?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: No, I'm afraid I have nothing in stock, largely due to the fact that I'm not really a trader, as I just mentioned.

steps.player: Ah yes, I remember!

options.text: You know, your cart IS kind of small!

steps.text: What are you implying?

steps.text: Why exactly are you still here?

steps.player: Okay, I better go!

confronting-surok-magis.speaker: Surok Magis
confronting-surok-magis.text: Oh really? And what makes you think you have even the slightest chance of doing that?

confronting-surok-magis.player: I'll fight you if I have to!

Surok teleports you out of his presence.

options.text: Have you any extra stock of battlestaffs I can buy?

steps.player: Rat Burgiss sent me!

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Ah, yes; You must be [player name]! Rat sent word that you would be coming. Everything is prepared. I have created a spell that will remove the mind control from the king.

steps.player: Okay, so what's the plan?

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Listen carefully. For the spell to succeed, the king must be made very weak. If his mind is controlled, you will need to fight him until he is all but dead.

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Then and ONLY then, use your ring to summon me. I will teleport to you and cast the spell that will cure the king.

steps.player: Why must I summon you? Can't you come with me?

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: I cannot. I must look after my shop here and I have lots to do. Rest assured, I will come when you summon me.

steps.player: Okay, so what do I do now?

steps.text: If the player does not have two free inventory spaces:

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: First, free up 2 inventory spaces so I can give you a couple of things.
If the player has at least two inventory spaces free:

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Take this beacon ring and some instructions.
a beacon ring and Zaff's instructions

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Once you have read the instructions, it will be time for you to arrest Surok.

steps.player: Won't he be disinclined to acquiesce to that request?

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Won't he what?

steps.player: Won't he refuse?

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: I very much expect so. It may turn nasty, so be on your guard. I hope we can stop him before he can cast his spell! Make sure you have that ring I gave you.

steps.player: Okay, thanks, Zaff!

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Rat has told me that you are to be made an honorary member of the VPSG so that you can arrest Surok. If you have any questions about this, ask Rat.

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: One last thing: you must remember that as part of the VPSG, we must remain secretive at all times. For this reason, I cannot discuss matters such as this unless absolutely necessary!

steps.player: Of course! Thanks again!

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Well, stop playing around; I'm a busy man!

talking-to-zaff-talking-to-zaff-again-op.text: If the player operates the ring whilst 10 tiles or more away from Zaff's shop:

steps.player: Sorry, I was just testing the ring.

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Look, stop messing around! My shop doesn't look after itself, you know! Hmm. Perhaps I could invent a spell that would do that...

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Besides, you probably need it more than me right now!

steps.player: I have been to see Zaff and he has told me to go and arrest Surok.

steps.player: So what happens now?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss

steps.player: Oooh! Do we have adventurer's insurance?

steps.player: Oh, well that sounds just as good!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Right then. You have an important task set out for you. Good luck, [player name]!

steps.player: What are my orders again?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: You will need to go and speak to Surok now. Arrest him under the authority of the Varrock Palace Secret Guard.

steps.player: Right then.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: It may be tough and Surok will most likely not be arrested without a fight, so be on your guard!

options.text: Can you tell me of the Dagon'hai?

steps.player: Can you tell me of the Dagon'hai?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: How do you know of them?

steps.player: Surok gave me a diary that spoke of them. Do you know anything about them?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: I see. The Dagon'hai were a powerful order of Zamorakian mages who resided here in this very city.

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: However, the priests of Saradomin warred ferociously with them and tried to destroy them. The Dagon'hai, though, were very clever and extremely cunning.

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: They hid themselves away within the city and, rumour has it, they even had a way of getting to the Wilderness and back without ever being seen, although I have no idea how that might have been.

steps.player: So where are they now?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Nobody knows. They disappeared from the city a hundred years ago and very few people even remember who they were.

steps.player: So how do you know about them?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: My grandfather's brother, my great uncle, was a priest of Saradomin and he would tell me stories of the wars with the Dagon'hai as a child.

steps.player: Oh, I see.

options.text: I've lost that ring I had!

steps.player: I've lost that ring I had!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: Then you will have to go and speak to Zaff at Zaff's Staffs to get another one!

steps.player: At ease, soldier!

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss
steps.text: You shouldn't mock your commanding officer, private! Don't forget, I can still have you arrested for conspiracy with Surok!

steps.player: Uh, yes, sorry! I forgot about that!

options.text: Can you tell me of the Dagon'hai?

steps.speaker: Rat Burgiss

while-fighting-king-roald.text: If King Roald has less than 5 hitpoints:

steps.text: Now would be a good time to summon Zaff!

while-fighting-king-roald.text: If the player activates the ring while King Roald is at or above 5 hitpoints:

steps.text: Zaff teleports from the ring and attempts to subdue King Roald...

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: The king's still too strong! We had better get out of here!

steps.player: Wait! Let me keep fighting!

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: It's too late! I cast the spell as soon as you summoned me, but it was too early! We need to withdraw and plan our attack again!
Zaff teleports the player back to his shop.

while-fighting-king-roald.text: If the player activates the ring when King Roald is below 5 hitpoints:

steps.text: Zaff appears, casting a special reverse curse spell on King Roald.

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Sin danna nim borha!
King Roald leans his body forward as if something left his body.
Zaff casts another spell, teleporting King Roald to a safe location.

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: The king's mind has been restored to him and he has been teleported away to safety. Now, to deal with Surok!

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: No! All is lost! I must escape!
Surok looks like he's trying to teleport away.

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: You will not escape justice this time, Surok!
Surok casts a special spell with two curse visual effects side by side.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Mirra din namus!
Zaff redirects Surok's spell back to him.

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Stop!!
Zaff casts a confuse spell on Surok, making him slump over.

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Your teleport spell has been corrupted, Surok! I have placed a magic block on this room. You will remain here, under guard, in the library from now on.

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: No! My plans have been ruined! I was so close to success!

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Thank you for your help, [player name]. I will put the room back in order and then I must leave. Surok is defeated and will be no more trouble for us. We will guard him more closely from now on!
Zaff teleports away, and the cutscene ends.
The room grows dark again and you sense objects moving...

while-fighting-king-roald.text: If the player attempts to talk to Surok during the fight:

steps.text: Surok's eyes are glazed over. He must be concentrating hard on the spell over King Roald.

while-fighting-king-roald.text: If the player uses the ring on Surok during the fight:

steps.speaker: Surok Magis
steps.text: Is that supposed to amuse me?

while-fighting-king-roald.text: If the player leaves the fight by exiting through the door:

steps.text: As you touch the door, your hand tingles and room seems to grow dim. You can hear Surok muttering a spell behind you...
The player is teleported to the south entrance of Varrock.
Zaff will now sell you battlestaves in his store, as a thank you for your help.

while-fighting-king-roald-talking-to-zaf.speaker: Zaff
while-fighting-king-roald-talking-to-zaf.text: Would you like to buy or sell some staffs? Or is there something else you need?

options.text: Have you any extra stock of battlestaffs I can buy?

steps.player: Why did you teleport us? We were winning!

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: The king was not weak enough and Surok's power over him was still too strong! You must weaken the king further before summoning me. Otherwise, we will fail.

steps.player: So what do I do now?

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: I am afraid we must try again. We will defeat Surok this time. I am sure of it!

options.text: Can I have the instructions again?

after-surok-has-been-defeated.text: If the player attempts to use the operate function on the ring on Surok, away from Varrock, or anyone else from the quest:

steps.text: Zaff has removed the summon charges from the ring. It will not summon him again.

after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.speaker: Surok Magis
after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.text: You have foiled my plans, [player name]... I obviously underestimated you.

after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.player: Yes. Let this be a lesson to you.

after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.speaker: Zaff
after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.text: Would you like to buy or sell some staffs? Or is there something else you need?

options.text: Have you any extra stock of battlestaffs I can buy?
We did it! We beat Surok!

steps.player: We did it! We beat Surok!

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Yes. You have done well, [player name]. You are to be commended for your actions!

steps.player: It was all in the call of duty!
What will happen with Surok now?

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Well, when I disrupted Surok's spell, he will have been sealed in the library, but we will still need to keep an eye on him, just in case.

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: When you are ready, report back to Rat and he will reward you.

steps.player: Okay, I will.

steps.speaker: Zaff
steps.text: Sadly, however, after this I will not be able to discuss these matters with you again. They are secret and we must be vigilant. The VPSG will prevail!

steps.player: Of course. I understand. Goodbye!

after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.speaker: Rat Burgiss
after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.text: Well, [player name], how did it go?

after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.player: You should have been there! There was this...and Surok was like...and I was...and then the King...and, and...uh...ahem! The mission was accomplished and the king has been saved.

after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.speaker: Rat Burgiss
after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.text: I take it that it went alright, then? That's great news!

after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.speaker: Rat Burgiss
after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.text: Zaff has already briefed me on the events. We will arrange for Surok to be fed and watched. I think he will not be a problem any more.

after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.player: You know, one thing bothers me. He's now stuck in the library, but wasn't that the reason we were in this mess in the first place?

after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.speaker: Rat Burgiss
after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.text: Yes, you are right. But rest assured, we will be watching him much more closely from now on.

after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.speaker: Rat Burgiss
after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.text: You've done very well and have been a credit to the VPSG; perhaps one day there may be a place for you here!

after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.speaker: Rat Burgiss
after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.text: In the meantime, let me reward you for what you've done, give you a little training. I will be sure to call on you if we ever need help in the future.
Continuing and completing the quest will grant you defence experience. You have already unlocked the ability to buy battlestaves. Are you sure you wish to continue?

after-surok-has-been-defeated-talking-to.prompt: Complete the quest and gain experience?

steps.text: Congratulations, you've completed a quest:What Lies Below

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-rat-burgi.speaker: Rat Burgiss
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-rat-burgi.text: Ah! [player name]! You did a fine service for us. You might make a good member of the VPSG one day, with a little training and a bit more muscle!

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-rat-burgi.player: So, do you have any more jobs for me to do?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-rat-burgi.speaker: Rat Burgiss
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-rat-burgi.text: At the moment, no. Things seem pretty quiet. However, I have heard a rumour about something strange going on in...hmm, no, I think we can handle this one for now.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-rat-burgi.speaker: Rat Burgiss
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-rat-burgi.text: But, who knows? We may need your assistance again soon. Thank you, [player name].

6VV4d7.speaker: Zaff
6VV4d7.text: You have one already. It's there in your inventory!

0lFl_X.speaker: Zaff
0lFl_X.text: Yes, I have another one, but you don't have any space for it. Speak to me when your inventory is less full!
